preconditions.description: The input text must be a string.

preconditions.expression: any(c.lower() in 'aeiou' for c in text)
preconditions.description: The input text must contain at least one vowel from the set 'aeiou' (case-insensitive).

postconditions.expression: round(sum(len(group) - 1 for group in vowel_groups if len(group) > 1) / len(vowel_groups), 2) == return_value
postconditions.description: The return value is the ratio of total extra repeated vowels (consecutive duplicates beyond the first in a run) to the total number of vowel groups, rounded to two decimal places. Vowel groups are contiguous sequences of vowels (case-insensitive 'aeiou') found in the text.
